decision.rationale: Use the candidate adapter for #157 because it preserves the flow-independent public/gold boundary while driving the actual T0, T1-v1, T1-v2 reactive, and T1-v2 autonomous services. This selects evaluation infrastructure only and does not promote V2.1.
limitations: Four synthetic network-free cases establish integration, not product quality or academic validity.
T0 and T1-v1 failed the current strict atomic-claim validator closed; issue #153 owns that grounding decision.

Provider-backed exact per-call accounting remains unexecuted, and the 820-case scripted timing must be rebound to the product's 24-hour wake-up semantics without changing public cases, gold, conditions, or gates.
Professor fidelity, external usability, and learning outcomes remain unsupported.
